source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Once this unit has fired in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), it may move up to 6″ as a Normal move provided it is out of [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of all enemy units; a unit that moves this way cannot declare a charge for the rest of the turn.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
